subject: Renewal negotiation + staged migration plan for Horizon Analytics (Outreach)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Horizon Outreach renewal — customer asks + timeline

Team — quick summary from this morning's call with Horizon (Carlos + procurement):

- Current Outreach renewal is due 2028-07-15; they have a blended seat mix (SDR, AE, CS) and want to consolidate two sequence tools into Outreach for FY29.
- Horizon asked for a staged commercial approach: (1) renew existing Outreach seats at a capped increase, (2) add a migration services block for 3 months, (3) a phased seat add over Q3–Q4.
- Procurement requested a single PO and a 60-day payment term; they also asked if Outreach can provide a small service credit or migration discount.

Action items I promised to coordinate: pricing pathway, migration SOW, any credit/discount ask that needs leadership approval. I tagged procurement into the MAP (see attachment) and asked Elena from Outreach to send an updated quote.

Ask: Karthik — recommend we (a) approve a one-time migration discount cap of up to 10% off services to speed consolidation, (b) permit a staged seat activation schedule in the contract, and (c) let procurement have a 60-day term for the initial PO given their corporate policy.

I tried to keep options tight so legal can turn the PO faster. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-Horizon-2028-05-31.xlsx (map of milestones), Horizon_Current_Tiers.csv (seat breakdown)

From: Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@outreach.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@horizon-analytics.com>, Horizon Procurement <procure@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-05-31T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Horizon Outreach renewal — customer asks + timeline

Thanks Ben — attaching our revised proposal. Highlights: 

- Term: 12 months starting on 2028-07-15.
- Commercial: flat 5% increase on base seats (to account for inflation/feature set) if Horizon signs by 2028-06-15.
- Migration services: we can offer a €12,000 (or USD equivalent) migration block with a 10% partner discount if Redwood manages the migration ops.
- Payment: Outreach can accept a 60-day PO for the initial term, but we require confirmation of renewal cadence and seat activation schedule at signing.

I've attached: Horizon_Outreach_Renewal_Proposal_2028-05-31.pdf and SOW-migration-assist-v1.docx. If you want to include a fallback clause (allowing them to revert to previous seat levels for 60 days during Q3), we can draft language.

Elena Roberts
Strategic Partnerships — Outreach

Attachments: Horizon_Outreach_Renewal_Proposal_2028-05-31.pdf; SOW-migration-assist-v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@outreach.io>, Horizon Procurement <procure@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon Outreach renewal — customer asks + timeline

Thanks all — read the outreach proposal and the attached MAP. My notes and recommended path: 

1) Commercial concession: authorize the 10% services discount (partner-managed) conditional on a signed MAP and a $75k minimum commitment across the next 12 months. The aim is to avoid ad-hoc scope creep while giving Horizon runway to consolidate.

2) Staggered seat activation: accept the phased activation schedule in the SOW (Q3 + Q4 toggles) with a hard cap on total activated seats through 2028 to protect unit economics. Legal can add an activation reporting cadence (monthly usage attestation).

3) Payment terms: approve 60-day initial PO on the first term only; after that, revert to net30 unless we have explicit procurement exceptions in writing. Procurement note: Soojin, please confirm whether Redwood Finance is comfortable with the one-time 60-day accommodation for this enterprise account and what governance we need on future exceptions.

4) Go/no-go on migration assist: Marissa, please scope a high-level implementation plan and costs (2-week on-site + remote support for 8 weeks) so we can finalize the SOW. If migration costs exceed the discounted services block, we escalate to me for approval.

5) Credits/SLAs: no additional uptime credits. Offer a short-term rollback window (60 days) in the contract instead.

If everyone agrees, I'll send a short internal approval note to finance/legal and request Outreach to prepare a redline-ready contract. We should target signing by 2028-06-12 to hit Elena's early-sign discount.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Roberts <elena.roberts@outreach.io>
Date: 2028-06-01T13:22:00-07:00

Agree with Karthik's approach. Approve the one-time 10% services discount conditioned on the $75k minimum commitment and the staged activation cap. Finance — please proceed with the 60-day PO exception for the initial term; we will require a written request from Horizon and a signed MAP before processing.

I'll notify our legal lead to prioritize the redline review so we can meet the 06/12 sign-by date.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
